726700103.text: Why hello! Someone suitable's arrived at last, I suppose... *cough*

726700104.text: And it's someone I know, too! Well, that's my worries about insufficient samples gone out the window!

726700105.text: I've been waiting this whole time, and if it isn't old folks, it's children... That's simply insufficient...

726700108.text: Oh, come on, I'm not some kind of nefarious villain, there's no need to pretend that we're not familiar or anything.

726700111.text: I mean, look, it's me! We met on Ritou, remember? *cough*

726700112.text: You still seem shady to me...

726700113.text: Ugh, alright, maybe you did forget me. *sigh* Alright, let me introduce myself again.

726700114.text: I'm Hosseini, a scholar from the Sumeru Akademiya. After a great many tribulations, I finally reached Inazuma to conduct research there.

726700115.text: Unfortunately, doing research on those islands was just too restrictive.

726700116.text: I did not leave empty-handed, of course, but considering all the trouble I went through, I have to say that it doesn't quite feel worth it in the end.

726700117.text: With few research funds remaining, I had to return to Sumeru via Liyue, but I did hope to rescue the situation during my travels...

726700118.text: And so I thought — why not return to the topic of the Energy Amplifier, my efforts in which the Akademiya had acknowledged prior?

726700119.text: Now, I'm not sure if you remember that whole affair...

726700120.text: But the Energy Amplifier is a precious ancient artifact that can use the ubiquitous ley lines to strengthen its user.

726700121.text: *cough* This research is still in its preliminary stages, and my previous report on it was only equivalent to a preface on the topic.

726700122.text: Much work remains to be done if we are to understand the workings of the Energy Amplifier in their entirety.

726700123.text: As such, I have been asking for volunteers and inviting them to use the Amplifier to obtain new data to support my research.

726700124.text: So I'm not... *cough* Not some kind of suspicious character. Please do not misunderstand.

726700126.text: Exactly. *cough* So, Traveler, if I might ask, would you be willing to be my volunteer and help to trial the Energy Amplifier?

726700128.text: Then allow me to express my thanks for your willingness thus far to make sacrifices in pursuit of ever-greater wisdom.

726700129.text: However, before I give the Energy Amplifier into your keeping, could we do a little warmup first?

726700130.text: It is proper procedure to first ascertain if the volunteer can defend themselves... *cough* No responsible academic study should play around with the lives of its volunteers, after all.

726700131.text: Once you are ready, head to the designated locations and clear out the monster encampments there.

726700132.text: I will wait for your return. Do remember to stay safe.

726700110.text: Oh, come on! Do I look like some mad scientist who grabs passersby to use for human experimentation? There's no need to take that cautious tone with me...

subQuests.subQuestName: Clear the three camps west of Wangshu Inn

726700203.text: Haha. *cough* Well, I suppose I worried over-much. You are very strong indeed — I shall have no fear in leaving the Energy Amplifier to you.

726700204.text: Its operation is very elementary — I trust you will understand it with a single glance.

726700205.text: However, do note that this is an authentic ancient relic. You will land me in no small amount of hot water should you lose it or break it.

726700206.text: As such, take your time to get used to it first before using it in tests.

726700301.text: How are things going? Is the Energy Amplifier proving easy to use?

726700303.text: Indeed. Compared to some of the instruments we use at the Akademiya, the Energy Amplifier certainly is a simpler tool.

726700306.text: At your level, larger-scale tests should be no problem at all.

726700307.text: I've heard passing adventurers mention that they've discovered some strange new Domain of late.

726700308.text: No one has ever traversed this terrain before, and it is teeming with monsters that are stronger than the ones you see wandering about in the wilds.

726700309.text: I reckon that if you use that for your testing site, we might be able to obtain better data.

726700310.text: I mean, your previous performances... *cough* I must say that they've been very impressive indeed. In fact, it is the data recorded by the Energy Amplifier that has been the limiting reactant here.

726700311.text: I reckon that even this domain shall not prove too difficult for you.

726700313.text: You know, I wouldn't have believed a word of it if someone else had told me that, but on the other hand, I have full faith that you'll be fine... *cough*

726700314.text: Well then, allow me to mark the location of this domain for you on your map. Happy testing!

726700305.text: Well, that's normal. Don't worry, as a non-professional user, you only need to grasp its basic operations.
